# FTH: Financial Transformation Hub

> Financial Transformation Hub (FTH) helps transform financial data and prepare IFRS-compliant reporting: financial reporting transformation from Ukrainian accounting standards (UAS, P(S)BO / П(С)БО) to IFRS.

## Services

- Local GAAP to IFRS transformation: full transformation of financial reporting from Ukrainian accounting standards to IFRS. Adjusting entries, reclassifications, explanatory notes.
- Full IFRS reporting package: preparation of a complete set of financial statements: statement of financial position, statement of profit or loss and OCI, cash flow statement, statement of changes in equity, and notes.
- Audit and due diligence support: preparation of documentation and working files for audit reviews. Communication with auditors, responding to queries, preparing additional disclosures.
- Financial reporting for external stakeholders: preparation and structuring of financial information for auditors, banks, investors, shareholders, parent companies, and international partners.

## Who we serve

- FTH Advisory provides services to companies from various sectors of the economy.

- Company: Financial Transformation Hub (FTH)
